title: CodeQuest — choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Engineer's Log. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Engineer's Log
options.lineage: engineering computation pads and bench notebooks
options.thesis: The product keeps a log: every mission a numbered entry, every submission taped in as evidence, every check witnessed and stamped.
options.viewport: The Dashboard as the open log page: a dated entry headline over a ruled index strip of six standing figures, the objective as the live entry, evidence taped in under a witness line.
options.risk: The log looks backward; if entry furniture outruns the next action it files a momentum product under history.

raised.raise: One measured ramp — numerals, tags and importance sit on a single fixed scale, so hierarchy is measured, never styled.
A hue owns a whole region — each course's ink fills entire strips and columns at page scale, never sprinkled accents.
Nothing disappears, it cancels — completed and voided entries over-stamp in place and keep their whole history.

options.label: The Transit Network
options.thesis: One network runs through the whole product: courses are lines, sections stations, missions stops, and every screen answers where you are and what's next.
options.viewport: The Dashboard as a network panel: the current course line drawn across the top with the learner's station marked live, the stops ahead carrying the action.
options.risk: A familiar progress metaphor: drawn timidly it is a colour scheme on the category dashboard, and a network that misrepresents the real sequence is worse than a list.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.thesis: State is line form, not colour: everything stands on one calibrated rail where dash, height and duplication carry the reading.
options.viewport: The Dashboard as one calibrated plate: the current signal doubled on the rail, every figure a line of a set height and dash.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for dense monitoring state; loses narrowly on identification — a spectrogram is the lab's, not the learner's.
options.risk: Precise at full commitment; softened, it is just a dark dashboard.

options.label: Plate Section
options.thesis: Almost-white stock where everything registers: hairline rules, crosshair marks and one seal, and nothing else decorates.
options.viewport: The Dashboard as a plate: a mono token bar, hairline-divided work areas, the objective at plate scale, one registered corner mark and a single seal.
options.case: Holds product clarity at the top of the category's craft; loses identification — it is the designer's world, not the student's.
options.risk: Extreme finish, thin world — the category standard in nicer stock.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.thesis: Every section is a hue board under a milk-acetate leaf, where ply is rank and states are punched, half-hinged or face-down.
options.viewport: The Dashboard on a chrome-yellow section board: the objective on the top ply, sections as a stepped tab rail whose heights are progress, machine codes in mono.
options.case: Holds clarity with real section hues and ply states; loses narrow on identification — boxed-software manuals are nostalgia, not today's classroom.
options.risk: The tab rail is a navigation model the mode forbids; kept as a signature move it is strong, unrestrained it becomes a manual costume.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Courses are constellations on a coordinate sky, where a star's magnitude is its importance and the figure layer fades up on request.
options.viewport: The Dashboard as the night's chart: the course constellation with the live star ringed in red, figures in tabular serif numerals.
options.case: A beloved chart world, but magnitudes hide row-level detail and the audience is students, not astronomers.
options.kept: One measured ramp — importance drawn on a fixed scale, never styled.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Every area is a swelling lobe of flat colour, and the coastline between lobes does all the dividing.
options.viewport: The Dashboard as a guide map: the current course a green lobe filling the page, missions as labeled capsules along the coast.
options.case: Fuses poorly: lobes become the layout and illustration-first reads as a children's product.
options.kept: Region-scale colour — a hue owns a whole field, never sprinkled accents.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: One journey per wallet: each leg is a carbon-copy coupon that validates, cancels and never disappears.
options.viewport: The Dashboard as the open wallet: every figure a ruled coupon field, the current mission the next leg, completed work cancelled in place.
options.case: Fuses partly: carbon states are honest, but travel happens to no one in a classroom.
options.kept: Nothing disappears, it cancels — states stamp and stay, so the record keeps its history.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The Dashboard the category expects — sidebar, stat cards, progress ring, friendly empty states — at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
